newsitem.title: USA: North Sea Brent crude gains in U.S. aftermarket.
newsitem.headline: North Sea Brent crude gains in U.S. aftermarket.

text.p: Thin dealings for North Sea Brent paper barrels resulted in slightly firmer prices, foreign crude traders said late Wednesday.
A cargo of July Brent was sold at $20.23, 11 cents firmer than the IPE settlement price of $20.12.
Traders said an additional 400 lots of outright paper was sold in four separate transactions. A pair of 100 lot slices sold at $20.17, and another pair of 100 lot deals moved at $20.15.
One inter-month spread was sold for June/July at plus seven cents, a slight improvement from talk in London.
